name: ViMUL-Bench
description:
ViMUL-Bench: A Culturally-diverse Multilingual Multimodal Video Benchmark
	





	
		
	
	
		Overview
	

The evaluation toolkit to be used is lmms-eval. This toolkit facilitates the evaluation of models across multiple tasks and languages.

	
	
	
		Key Features
	


🌍 14 Languages: English, Chinese, Spanish, French, German, Hindi, Arabic, Russian, Bengali, Urdu, Sinhala, Tamil, Swedish, Japanese🎭 15 Categories: Including 8 culturally diverse categories (lifestyles, festivals, foods… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/MBZUAI/ViMUL-Bench.
reputation: Hosted on Hugging Face and released by MBZUAI, ViMUL-Bench is an emerging multilingual multimodal video benchmark with growing community interest.
